name: Tough Commerce
long_description: Tough Commerce is the only white-label commerce platform tailored for industry-specific workflows and enable merchants, suppliers, producers and manufacturers to digitize their processes. Behind the scenes, we  provides order management, location management, pricing management,  dispatching, logistics, messaging, e-ticketing, invoicing, customer portal, AR automation, payment, payouts and real-time delivery capabilities through driver app. With financial and operational ERP integrations, our technology can operate stand-alone or seamlessly alongside deeply integrated products.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Founder of Nodebridge, an AI-powered founding studio building companies in skilled trades and real-world industries. Previously founded Tough Commerce (YC W20), a commerce platform for construction suppliers, where he now serves on the board.
